title: GOV-0024: normalize badf-research contract layout and make bounded research scope machine-readable
problem:
## Observed
On `main` at `8896a37`, the `badf-research` contract is frozen and partially enforced (16/18 controls), but its canonical concepts are still bundled under the v0.1 file layout: depth is embedded in `research-types.md`, lifecycle/state semantics are in `lifecycle.md`, routing/authority are in `routing-and-authority.md`, and admission controls are in `acceptance.md`. The root skill already requires stop conditions, but `schemas/research-record.schema.json` cannot record `assumptions`, `decision_context`, or `stop_conditions`, so a material research run cannot prove why it continued or why it stopped.

## Expected
Continue the contract as one canonical `badf-research` family with a normalized reference surface:

```text
skills/badf-research/
├── SKILL.md
└── references/
    ├── research-contract.md
    ├── research-types.md
    ├── research-depth.md
    ├── research-state-machine.md
    ├── evidence-contract.md
    ├── routing-authority.md
    └── acceptance-controls.md

schemas/research-record.schema.json
docs/14-research-capability.md
badf/skill-registry.json
```

The schema must make bounded framing first-class with `assumptions`, `decision_context`, and non-empty `stop_conditions`. The root `SKILL.md`, schema, examples/template and drift tests must agree. Existing authority topology remains unchanged: `RESEARCH_SUFFICIENT != IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZED`; no second validator, router or council; `badf-research` remains `DESIGNED`.

## Evidence
- `skills/badf-research/SKILL.md` already instructs the researcher to resolve stop conditions.
- `schemas/research-record.schema.json` currently has `question`, `scope`, `known`, `unknown`, `hypotheses` but no machine-readable stop conditions/assumptions/decision context.
- `tests/test_badf_research_contract.py` hard-codes the older reference paths, so the current layout is itself contract-bound and must be migrated deliberately.

## Unknowns
Control 6 (live source-digest staleness) remains a separate subsequent work package because it requires source acquisition/fetch semantics. The remaining eight P0 subskills remain incremental follow-ons.

## Proposed work package
`WP-2026-0041` / research contract normalization and bounded-scope hardening. C2. Rename/split the normative reference surface, add the framing fields to the schema and examples/template, add one normative integration document, update contract tests, re-pin the root skill digest and integrity lockfile. No activation and no new execution tool.
